scope: Main BCpl8s plate/topic navigation (links 1–55), specialty programme link 65 and selected linked child families. Family-level audit, not exhaustive specimen adjudication.
limitations: No repository checkout, test suite or browser-render comparison was completed in this review.
No font or glyph masters were produced.
Thousands of referenced photographs have not each been visually inspected.
Repository reference-index inclusion is not independently checked per family in this manifest.
Documented source attribution may be tentative and does not certify actual issuance.

counts.countsUnit: Inventory topics and presets, NOT distinct historical plate designs

repositoryEvidence.title: 41 passenger presets, not 25
repositoryEvidence.finding: The registry combines 25 early presets with 16 later presets. Existing documentation has not fully caught up.

repositoryEvidence.title: Reference imports are not editable designs
repositoryEvidence.finding: The recorded import has 320 B.C. pages, 30 failed URLs, 10 manual Leeward references and 16,474 unique image references. It reports zero editable designs imported from images; existing manually built templates still exist.

repositoryEvidence.title: Default inscriptions use a proxy typeface
repositoryEvidence.finding: Barlow Condensed / Arial Narrow is used for default lettering. Estimated text widths and spacingAndGlyphs fitting do not recover historical outlines.

repositoryEvidence.title: Procedural lettering is category-level
repositoryEvidence.finding: Shared centreline strokes, 56-unit alphanumeric advances, an 8-unit gap and a single stroke weight are not maker-specific dies. Width fitting can reduce overall height.

repositoryEvidence.title: Lettering selection misses other inscription roles
repositoryEvidence.finding: The selectable construction modes affect the serial only, not province, dates, renewal text or slogans.

repositoryEvidence.title: 1985 fourth block is missing
repositoryEvidence.finding: The blue-base recipes stop at the third block. BCpl8s documents a fourth block; this is distinct from the also-missing 1985 flag base.

repositoryEvidence.title: An ACME preset is not an ACME glyph set
repositoryEvidence.finding: The 1978 ACME serial subset exists, but its precise Quebec-style dies are explicitly not reproduced.

repositoryEvidence.title: Keep the renewal work that already exists
repositoryEvidence.finding: 1951 strip and 1953/54 tabs, loose/base-only modes, W/Y entries and blank-base options already exist. Some accompanying notes incorrectly describe these as absent.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Early rounded historical dies
proposedDieProfiles.scope: Existing 1940–1954 passenger reconstructions; boundaries require specimen review
proposedDieProfiles.task: Rebuild digit silhouettes, counter shapes, slant and narrow legends from multiple straight-on originals; do not equate generic oval with a recovered die.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Oakalla block-era variants
proposedDieProfiles.scope: Existing 1955 onward historical plates; split only where supported
proposedDieProfiles.task: Build numerals plus independent province/date faces; preserve documented year-specific differences.

proposedDieProfiles.label: ACME narrow / Quebec-style
proposedDieProfiles.task: Use the B.C. numeral comparison specimens, not Quebec comparators alone.

proposedDieProfiles.label: ACME blue-base comparison
proposedDieProfiles.task: Check differences against the 1978 set before deciding which master geometry can be shared.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Hi-Signs / Nova Scotia-style
proposedDieProfiles.task: Rebuild from B.C. specimens; use approximate transition evidence rather than a universal hard serial boundary.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Astrographic male/female die form
proposedDieProfiles.task: Build a separately evidenced profile, not a year-only automatic rule.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Astrographic neoprene-top form
proposedDieProfiles.task: Record stroke and counter changes independently of plate wear.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Astrographic non-passenger form
proposedDieProfiles.task: Allow cross-class use only for documented specimens; a class name is not an exclusive assignment rule.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Astrographic classic form
proposedDieProfiles.task: Reconstruct independently before measuring shared geometry.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Waldale
proposedDieProfiles.scope: Late-2002/2003 transition onward; overlaps and exceptions exist
proposedDieProfiles.task: Do not label all 2001 numeric-first plates Waldale; carry specimen evidence and maker exceptions.

proposedDieProfiles.label: Small-format class-specific profiles
proposedDieProfiles.scope: Motorcycle, off-road, dealer motorcycle and related forms
proposedDieProfiles.task: Measure actual small-format dies and legends rather than scaling a full-size master.

officialSerialConfigurationReference.notation: @ = variable letter; # = variable digit; other printed letters are literal. Dash placement is separate layout data.
officialSerialConfigurationReference.status: Announced configurations, not a claim every type is already in circulation
officialSerialConfigurationReference.note: ICBC says the new configurations retain six characters and do not by themselves change the plate design/material. Keep inventory-transition exceptions.

records.name: Passenger
distinctions: 42 registered presets: 25 early (1940–1963) and 17 later (1964–1985) passenger bases and variants.
Pre-1940 passenger designs and the 1985 flag base onward are absent.
The 1985 fourth serial block on the blue 1979 base was added after this review.
records.nextAction: Correct existing die profiles; add missing base families and separately identified production variants.
records.caution: A preset is not an annual issue count. “Through 1985” refers to the blue 1979 base, not the flag design.

records.name: Antique
distinctions: Full-size and motorcycle forms; early large numerals and later smaller numeral settings.
Samples and prototypes need separate evidence records.
records.nextAction: Create antique artwork and size profiles; do not reuse Collector as a synonym.

records.name: APEC
distinctions: 1997 provincial motorcade plates and separate military event plates.
records.nextAction: Keep issuer, event role and artwork variant explicit.

records.name: BC Parks
distinctions: Kermode bear, Purcell Mountains and Porteau Cove are three artwork masters.
Serial-block changes do not necessarily create a new artwork design.
records.nextAction: Build three graphics with shared full-size components and versioned serial rules.

records.name: Chauffeur Badges
distinctions: Class and year variants; metal and wartime fibreboard examples.
records.nextAction: Use badge templates, not the vehicle plate generator.

records.name: Collector
distinctions: Passenger, multi-vehicle/floater, motorcycle and motorcycle floater.
Maker, numeral, decal-well and serial-generation changes.
records.nextAction: Model vehicle class and multi-vehicle status independently.

records.name: Commercial Truck
distinctions: Historical annual and multi-year bases; full commercial chronology is distinct from passenger.
records.nextAction: Reuse measured shells where justified; supply class-specific lettering and serial grammars.

records.name: Consular
distinctions: Historical CONSUL bases, flag-era bases, and the red 2007 design.
Red-series categories: DL, CC, HC, CS and SR.
records.nextAction: Add five category prefixes to one red-base family; keep historical CONSUL legends distinct.

records.name: Dealer
distinctions: Early dealer construction, later D legends, big-D/little-D variants.
Motorcycle dealer is a separate size and serial family.
records.nextAction: Build dealer-specific legends and prefixes; do not just prepend D to a passenger serial.

records.name: Decals
distinctions: Passenger, commercial and sample decals; distinct annual graphics and day/month arrangements.
records.nextAction: Create a reusable dated decal library and compatibility rules for plate wells.
records.caution: Historical decal graphics are not evidence that decals remain required today. Check official contemporary policy.

records.name: Driver’s Licences
distinctions: Historical driver documents, rather than vehicle plate designs.
records.nextAction: Catalogue as documents with separate layouts and evidence.

records.name: Expo 86
distinctions: Presentation/personalized examples, Expo renewal decal and booster/souvenir plates.
Other jurisdictions’ pavilion examples are not B.C. road issues.
records.nextAction: Split road, renewal, souvenir and outside-jurisdiction examples.

records.name: Farm / Farm Tractor
distinctions: F-marked agricultural plates; separate from the farm-truck family.
records.nextAction: Build farm-tractor recipes and keep the meaning of F tied to class and period.
records.caution: Do not retroactively interpret every historical passenger F prefix as a farm plate.

records.name: Foreign Touring
distinctions: 1924 F plates and associated windshield documents.
records.nextAction: Separate plate and permit artefacts; preserve the historical meaning of F.

records.name: Government
distinctions: 1948 E government issue.
records.nextAction: Add the documented government recipe, not a generic modern government plate.

records.name: Guinness / Victoria hired vehicles
distinctions: The article identifies the disputed Victoria porcelain plate as a 1913 municipal hired-vehicle issue.
Comparative lettering and municipal badges are additional evidence.
records.nextAction: Cross-link to municipal designs rather than creating a “world-record” plate class.

records.name: Ham Radio
distinctions: VE7 and VA7 call-sign arrangements; historical spacing and maker changes.
records.nextAction: Use call-sign grammar and separate layouts for short and longer runs.

records.name: Industrial Vehicle
distinctions: Historical X-prefix bases; maker changes; new serial configuration announced in 2025.
records.nextAction: Keep industrial separate from restricted and off-road; version serial rules.

records.name: Keytags
distinctions: Miniature plate-like tags are not full-scale die specimens.
records.nextAction: Catalogue tag shapes and makers separately.

records.name: Lieutenant Governor
distinctions: Heraldic plaques, crest changes, smaller vehicle examples and a personalized example.
records.nextAction: Keep heraldic plaques separate from standard plates carrying personalized text.

records.name: Logging
distinctions: Historical forestry/logging prefixes and later logging bases.
records.nextAction: Build a logging family; link Special Agreement and company VIN identification without merging them.
records.caution: Some early prefix dates and allocations remain uncertain.

records.name: Manufacturer
distinctions: MANUFACTURER legend forms, later MA forms and reused base components.
records.nextAction: Create independent legend placement and class grammar.

records.name: Medical Doctor
distinctions: Early reserved passenger numbers, PN plates and doctor-related toppers.
records.nextAction: Distinguish allocation-only examples from genuinely different plate designs.

records.name: Memorial Cross
distinctions: Road plate and keepsake versions need separate records.
records.nextAction: Build an artwork master with explicit road/keepsake type.

records.name: Motive Fuel
distinctions: Early-1960s and later-1960s layouts; related fuel-tax decals.
records.nextAction: Treat tax identification as a supplementary family rather than a passenger base.

records.name: Motor Carrier
distinctions: Letter-classification plates, changing layouts and later decals.
records.nextAction: Represent carrier class, period and artefact type independently.

records.name: Motorcycle
distinctions: Own size chronology and dies; later larger characters, B.C. mark and well changes.
records.nextAction: Create size-specific masters; do not scale full-size plates indiscriminately.

records.name: Movie Props
distinctions: Fictional serials, altered legends, construction and layouts.
records.nextAction: Keep a prop collection explicitly separate from historical issued designs.

records.name: Municipal
distinctions: City-issued commercial/vehicle-for-hire plates, provincial municipal series and later labels.
records.nextAction: Use issuing municipality as a first-class field; catalogue local shapes independently.

records.name: National Defence
distinctions: B.C.-issued N plates, motorcycle examples and later federal military plates.
records.nextAction: Separate B.C. historical issues from Canada-wide military jurisdiction.

records.name: National Parks
distinctions: Attributed early red-border plates; buffalo radiator badges, toppers and permits.
records.nextAction: Keep federal park-access artefacts separate from modern B.C. Parks plates.
records.caution: The early red-border plate attribution is an interpretation in the source, not a fully verified issue record.

records.name: Off-Road Vehicle
distinctions: Metal plate and adhesive registration sticker are distinct artefacts.
records.nextAction: Build both formats with their own dimensions and typography.

records.name: Olympics
distinctions: Six forms: passenger, truck, farm truck, commercial trailer, motorcycle and utility trailer.
records.nextAction: Use shared Olympic artwork with six class/size/serial recipes, not one passenger template.

records.name: Passenger Carrier
distinctions: Regular passenger-carrier identification and yellow Olympic-period temporary examples.
records.nextAction: Keep distinct from motor-carrier classifications and from consumer Olympic plates.

records.name: Personalized
distinctions: Full-size and motorcycle layouts; varying spacing, emblem positioning and makers.
records.nextAction: Use its own grammar, centring rules and artwork placement.
records.caution: Promotional or sample examples are not proof of the ordinary issued serial rules.

records.name: Prototype
distinctions: Colour trials, unreleased concepts and altered/repainted specimens.
records.nextAction: Record experimental status and evidence; do not expose as an ordinary issued year.

records.name: Prorated
distinctions: Annual and multi-year P-series; decal and layout variants.
records.nextAction: Add base recipes plus versioned prorate serial patterns.

records.name: Public Works
distinctions: Historical PW plates.
records.nextAction: Use documented specimens and retain unknown end dates as unknown.

records.name: Reciprocity
distinctions: Historical metal plates and later interjurisdictional decals.
records.nextAction: Keep uncertain early examples marked tentative.

records.name: Repairer
distinctions: REPAIRER and REPAIRMAN inscriptions; changing top/bottom placement.
records.nextAction: Model legend text and location by period instead of merely changing serials.

records.name: Restricted
distinctions: AT-prefix and X-suffix forms; maker-specific spacing differences.
records.nextAction: Separate from industrial X-prefix and off-road registrations.

records.name: Royal Visits
distinctions: 1951, ROYAL-series, Commonwealth Games and later heraldic forms.
Trial/prototype designs must remain distinct.
records.nextAction: Use event-specific components and avoid assuming one universal royal plate.

records.name: Sample
distinctions: Passenger and non-passenger samples; renewal pieces and decal samples.
Zero-filled serials and manufacturing sample inscriptions can be legitimate sample evidence.
records.nextAction: Add sample status and a separate validation grammar; distinguish souvenirs.

records.name: Special Agreement
distinctions: Gold River GR and Cominco CL families; later consolidated SA form.
records.nextAction: Represent GR, CL and SA as linked but distinct recipes.
records.caution: Some historical allocation ranges are explicitly estimates; recent sightings do not define a continuous issuance range.

records.name: Temporary Permits
distinctions: Operating, testing/demonstration and interim forms; later serial-format changes.
Early undated X-plate attribution is tentative.
records.nextAction: Add paper dimensions and fields; distinguish TOP from COVID-era TNP.

records.name: Trailer / Commercial Trailer
distinctions: Commercial trailer chronology; utility and floater are separate linked families.
records.nextAction: Create separate commercial, utility and floater recipes.
records.caution: Do not infer that every historical T prefix denotes a trailer.

records.name: Transporter
distinctions: Changing legend positions; later TR and TS sequences.
records.nextAction: Build transporter-specific legends and grammar.

records.name: Veteran
distinctions: Passenger, truck and motorcycle types.
records.nextAction: Build shared commemorative artwork with class-specific layout and serial rules.

records.name: VIN Program
distinctions: Large forestry-company vehicle identification boards.
records.nextAction: Keep company identification separate from road registrations and modern 17-character VINs.

records.name: Highs
distinctions: Observed high numbers assist chronology and allocation research.
records.nextAction: Attach observations to recipes; do not generate a new design for each high.

records.name: Lows
distinctions: Low-number specimens can help assess spacing and die dimensions.
records.nextAction: Attach observations to recipes rather than counting every low as a base.

records.name: Bicycles
distinctions: Municipal plates and labels; multiple local shapes and materials.
The index includes Prince George and Williams Lake.
records.nextAction: Add issuer-specific bicycle families and do not infer unknown years.

records.name: Front Plate Debate
distinctions: Homepage-linked policy/history topic, not a distinct plate family.
records.nextAction: Keep as contextual research.

records.name: Historic Numbers
distinctions: Pre-provincial number history is evidence for early passenger records.
records.nextAction: Link to early specimens without converting numbers into separate visual designs.

records.name: Miscellaneous
distinctions: Conference commemoratives, event boards, uncertain prototypes and other curios.
Linked collections: boosters, reproduction/counterfeit examples, fire departments and toppers.
records.nextAction: Classify individual records before rendering; keep uncertain attribution explicit.

records.name: Specialty programme / proposals
distinctions: Proposed themed plates and comparative examples from other jurisdictions.
records.nextAction: Do not mark proposal artwork as an issued B.C. design.

records.name: Farm Truck
distinctions: A and G historical series; newer A-suffix configuration.
records.nextAction: Create farm-truck base and serial recipes, separate from F farm tractors.

records.name: Motorcycle Dealer
distinctions: Motorcycle-sized dealer forms and later DM serials.
records.nextAction: Add a motorcycle-dealer layout and grammar.

records.name: Utility Trailer
distinctions: Utility trailer series and associated special-issue forms.
records.nextAction: Build separately from commercial trailer.

records.name: Trailer Floater
distinctions: Multi-trailer/floater identification, distinct from a normal trailer registration.
records.nextAction: Create its own recipe family.

records.name: Temporary Number Plates
distinctions: COVID-era paper number plates, superficially similar to TOP forms.
records.nextAction: Keep separate from temporary operating permits and model historically, not as a current entitlement.

records.name: Boosters
distinctions: Promotional plate-like objects are not proof of provincial road issuance.
records.nextAction: Add an explicitly non-issued creative catalogue.

records.name: Reproductions / Counterfeits
distinctions: Examples help exclude modern reproductions from historical die calibration.
records.nextAction: Record provenance warnings, not a verified historical master.

records.name: Fire Department plates
distinctions: Local department artwork and plate-like identifiers.
records.nextAction: Record issuer and use; do not automatically label all as provincial registrations.

records.name: Toppers and Radiator Badges
distinctions: Accessories mounted above plates or on radiators.
records.nextAction: Create accessory components, not standard plate shells.

records.name: Prince George bicycle plates
distinctions: Tin examples; dates and dimensions are not established on the source page.
records.nextAction: Catalogue pictured specimens without inventing dates or exact scale.
records.caution: Manufacturer attribution is marked estimated/unconfirmed in the source.

records.name: Williams Lake bicycle plates
distinctions: Plastic example under a 1977–unknown heading; dimensions and issuer chronology incomplete.
records.nextAction: Reconstruct a documented specimen only after checking a usable reference.
